payload.notes: Start. Openings right and down; exploring right branch first. Track coordinates from successful moves.
At (1,0), right branch is a dead end downward; left returns to start. Backtracking to explore the start's down branch.
Returned to start after checking the right branch. Now exploring the down branch.
At (0,-1) after entering the start's down branch. Continue downward to explore the corridor; the next visible cell offers an exit to the right.
At (0,-2), continuing downward corridor. The next cell has a right branch to explore later.
At (0,-2); downward is blocked. Explore the long open corridor to the right before backtracking.
At (1,-2), traversing the long right corridor. Continue right to inspect its branches and far end.
At (3,-2), continuing along the horizontal corridor toward its far end; no branches at current cell.
At (4,-2), the corridor continues right to a cell with an upward branch and left return. Explore right, then take the new branch upward.
At (5,-2); moved right into a junction. Explore the open upward branch first.
At (5,-1) after moving up from the far-right junction. Explore the open right branch; it appears to lead to a new cell with a downward return route.
At (6,-1); right branch is a dead end. Move down into the newly revealed branch and continue exploring.
At (6,-2) after descending from the right-side dead end. Open up and right; explore the right corridor first.
At (7,-2) in a horizontal corridor. Continue right to inspect the far end and any new branch.
At (8,-2); right and up are blocked. Explore the open downward branch, which leads to a cell offering a left continuation.
At the lower branch endpoint. Up returns to the prior corridor; explore left for an unvisited continuation.
At (7,-3), a horizontal corridor. Continue left to explore the unvisited branch; right returns to the recently checked lower endpoint.
At (6,-3), after moving left. Open right returns along the explored corridor; take the downward branch to explore new territory.
At (6,-4) after descending. Down is blocked; right leads back through explored corridor. Explore the unvisited left junction.
At the newly reached left junction. Up and right appear to connect to explored routes; take the downward branch to continue exploring.
At (5,-3). The left branch is a dead end returning right; continue up through the unexplored corridor.
At the junction after returning from the lower branch. Up is a short dead end; down is explored. Explore the open right corridor and its junction.
At (6,-2) after moving right from the junction. The right and up routes are explored; backtrack left toward the earlier junction at (4,-2), whose downward branch remains unexplored.
At the junction after returning from the right branch. Up is a dead end; right is explored. Recheck the downward branch for any remaining continuation.
At the lower junction after moving down. Left is a dead end; proceed upward through the remaining corridor and inspect the next junction.
At the junction; right and down are explored. Check the short upward branch before backtracking.
At the short upward dead end; only down is open. Return to the junction and continue systematic backtracking.
Returned from the upward dead end. Move left to the earlier junction, then explore its unvisited downward branch.
Left is blocked at this junction; prior branches appear explored. Move right to continue systematic exploration and seek an unvisited route.
At (6,-2); right is a dead end and upper/lower branches are explored. Backtrack left toward the central corridor to search remaining routes.
At the junction after backtracking from the right branch. Up and right lead to explored dead ends; down returns through the lower explored route. Continue systematic backtracking.
At the lower junction; left leads to a dead end. Continue upward through the corridor to explore beyond the visible cells.
At the recurring junction; upward branch is a dead end and downward branch returns to a dead end. Move right to backtrack into the broader corridor and search for remaining routes.
At the right-side junction; the right endpoint and upper branch are explored. Backtrack left toward the central corridor to search for remaining paths.
At the junction after returning from the right branch. Its up, down, and right branches have been explored; backtrack right through the corridor toward earlier unexplored areas.
At the junction reached by moving right. The right branch is a dead end; backtrack left toward the central corridor and search for remaining unexplored paths.
At the junction; left is blocked. The upper and right branches are exhausted, so descend through the lower corridor and continue systematic backtracking toward unvisited areas.
At the lower dead-end corridor; left leads to a confirmed dead end. Move up to return to the junction and continue backtracking toward unexplored areas.
At the recurring junction. Up and right routes have been exhausted; descend into the lower branch and inspect its leftward continuation for an unvisited route.
At the lower corridor endpoint; the left branch is confirmed dead-ended. Move up to return to the junction and continue backtracking toward unexplored areas.
At the junction again; nearby up and down branches appear exhausted. Move right to leave this loop and continue searching the broader corridor for an unseen exit.
At the right-side junction; return left toward the earlier corridor junction at x=4, where the downward branch remains unexplored.
At the recurring junction. Nearby up and down branches have been explored; continue right through the corridor to search beyond the loop.
Return left to the junction, then systematically revisit the remaining connected branches rather than oscillating through the right dead end.
At the junction again. The right-side loop is exhausted; inspect the short upward branch once more, then backtrack through the lower corridor if needed.
At the upward dead end; only down is open. Return to the junction and continue systematic exploration without repeating the right-side loop.

At the right junction. Right is blocked/dead-ended; left returns to the central junction. Recheck the upward branch for any hidden exit or continuation.
At the upper-right cell; right is a known dead end and down returns to the junction. Descend, then backtrack west toward the start to find unexplored branches.
Moved left from the upper-right cell to the junction. Known nearby branches are exhausted; continue exploring from this junction.
At the recurring junction; investigate the lower branch again, prioritizing any connection that may have been misclassified during earlier backtracking.
At the lower corridor cell; left is a confirmed dead end. Move up to the junction and avoid repeating this branch.
At the junction after returning from the lower dead end. Explore the right-adjacent junction once more for any overlooked continuation.
At the right junction; right is a dead end and the upper branch has already been checked. Backtrack left to the central junction and continue searching elsewhere.

At the right junction; move up to revisit the upper branch and check for any overlooked continuation.

At the right junction; the right branch is a dead end. Explore the upward branch now before backtracking left.

At the upper corridor, continue right into the newly visible cell and inspect its upward branch before backtracking.

At (7,3); left returns to (6,3), whose downward branch remains unexplored. Backtrack left, then investigate down.
At (6,3); right returns to the explored corridor, while down is the remaining unexplored branch. Investigate downward.
